resource_counting_semantics.depth: root is depth 1; every map/list child increments once
resource_counting_semantics.nodes: every map, list and scalar is one node; mapping keys are counted separately as keys, not nodes
resource_counting_semantics.references: every scalar occurrence in a schema-declared *_id, *_ids, *_reference, *_commitment, record_ids, supersedes or via_assertion_ids field; duplicates each charge
resource_counting_semantics.resolution_charges: one per JSON node reconstructed plus one per indexed/reference lookup and one per public validator row visited; must be incrementally enforced
resource_counting_semantics.resolved_bytes: sum of canonical request, reconstructed snapshot and recomputed prior semantic input; never substituted by reference indirection
resource_counting_semantics.wire_bytes: captured read-once file bytes before decode; limit+1 read only

resource_probe_constructors.at_limit: construct valid padding only in schema-authorized bounded note fields until the named exact build ceiling; semantic fields unchanged
resource_probe_constructors.plus_one: same object as its at-limit twin plus one UTF-8 byte/node/depth/reference/digit/row in the named dimension; preserve earlier dimensions within ceiling so the intended stage is first
resource_probe_constructors.refusal_safety: read at most wire ceiling plus one; no output directory before complete bounded semantic serialization; no partial conclusion in a refusal
